items.label: 256GB Large Storage
items.value: With TCL 10L cell phone you can store and access massive photos, videos, music, books and files, no worry about the storage running out.Octa-core processor and 6GB of RAM provide you a smooth experience.

items.label: 6.53” FHD+ Dotch LCD display
items.value: Powered by NXTVISION, will upgrade your visual experience with the sharper details, vibrant images and allow you to enjoy true-to-life color accuracy in everything you present.TCL 10L Unlocked Android Smartphone is made for the US with a one-year US warranty.

items.label: Superior clarity day & night
items.value: Coming with a 48MP high-res AI camera(48MP+8MP+2MP+2MP) and 16MP front-facing selfie camera, TCL 10L android phone helps you capture crisp and vivid pictures. The AI-powered camera recognizes and enhances scenes & objects for your best creations.

items: Compatible with GSM carriers(AT&T and T-Mobile). TCL 10L mobile phone is also certified for use on Verizon’s LTE network. If your device is not receiving messages or experiences an error when making phone calls on Verizon, your account may need to be provisioned to support “CDMA-less” devices, please contact Verizon’s technical support team or your account’s business representative for assistance. This phone is not compatible with CDMA networks. (such as Sprint, Spectrum, Xfinity, etc.)

items.label: Comfortable viewing all day
items.value: Auto-adjusting display provides the best viewing experience regardless of lighting conditions. A 4000mAh battery and Intelligent Battery Mode optimize power usage to keep you cord-free all day. Please know that on TCL 10L phone WIFI calling is only compatible with T-Mobile.
